sources.name: AGMARKNET 2.0 market price and arrival reports
sources.provider: Directorate of Marketing and Inspection, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

model.selection_threshold: Histogram gradient boosting must reduce MAE by at least 1% versus the best baseline

prediction_interval.method: Expanding-window absolute-error quantiles from earlier evaluation folds

definitions.modalPrice: The most frequently reported wholesale price for the market day.
definitions.weeklyCoverage: Share of active weeks containing at least one source report.
definitions.forecastInterval: An empirical range calibrated from earlier rolling-origin errors.
definitions.netRealization: Forecast or observed price × quantity in quintals − user-entered transport cost.
definitions.anomaly: A robust statistical flag for an unusual price; not proof of a source error.
